# Hex log for 2026-11-13-archived-rc-captures.md

One bullet per decoded message: relay time (VM clock, UTC), connection number and port label, direction, **id**, length, then hex of GCHAR id + payload. Bold lines are the UI steps. Periodic S>C 42, C>S 162 and empty C>S 103 keepalives are left out. Messages over 800 bytes show their first 48 bytes, their length and a SHA-256 prefix. The password in logins is the lab password `labpw`. The two machine ids in the GSERV025 identity are replaced with `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef`.
